newsitem.title: TURKEY: TURKISH SHARES BARELY CHANGED IN MIXED TRADE.
newsitem.headline: TURKISH SHARES BARELY CHANGED IN MIXED TRADE.

text.p: Istanbul shares ended mixed on Wednesday after trading in narrow ranges due to resistance awaited at between the index's 1,600 and 1,650 levels and lack of market moving news, brokers said.

The IMKB National-100 closed two points, or 0.13 percent firmer at 1,592 after moving between 1,580 and 1,614. It lost 1.43 percent in profit-taking on Tuesday after leaping 3.93 percent on easing political concerns on Monday.
Trade volume increased to 27.38 trillion lira from Tuesday's 25.62 trillion.

"Trade remains quiet because there is no positive expectation to drive the market. Political uncertainty is still a negative factor, I expect trade to continue this way tomorrow," said Tolga Ozkan Okay from Evis securities.

Of the 241 shares traded, 103 declined, 83 advanced and 55 closed stable. The IMKB Industrial edged up 0.32 percent to 1,583, the IMKB Services rose 1.09 percent to 1,479 while the IMKB Financial eased 0.64 percent to 1,716.

Actives were led by utility Cukurova Elektrik, up 7,500 lira at 222,500, largely state-owned flat steel maker Eregli, steady at 17,250 lira, T.Isbank's C series, down 1,500 lira at 46,500 and automotive producer Otosan, up 3,000 lira at 79,000.
They made up 34.4 percent of the total turnover.
